class.name: NetwChannel
class.brief_description: A raw byte channel multiplexed over the session carrier, addressed by a channel [member id].
class.description:
Use this for session-scoped traffic that has no entity to associate with, such as a voice stream, a chat line, or a compressed world grid. Ids run [code]100[/code] to [code]254[/code]. Give each channel a distinct [member id] and call [method register] once per peer. [codeblock] # both peers, once: var chat := Netw.channel(self, 120) chat.register(func(sender: int, payload: PackedByteArray) -> void: show_line(sender, payload.get_string_from_utf8()) )
# any peer, any time: chat.broadcast("gg".to_utf8_buffer()) [/codeblock] Pass [code]batched[/code] as [code]true[/code] to [method send] or [method broadcast] to aggregate payloads into the shared peer buffers the session flushes at the end of its frame.

method.name: broadcast
method.description: Broadcasts the custom channel payload to all other connected peers.

method.name: of
method.description: Opens channel [param id] over the session governing [param node], or returns [code]null[/code] and reports when no session governs it or [param id] is outside [code]100[/code] to [code]254[/code]. [method Netw.channel] is the front door and this is what it returns.

method.name: register
method.description: Registers a [param handler] to receive payloads for this custom channel. The [param handler] is called as [code]handler(sender: int, payload: PackedByteArray)[/code].

method.name: send
method.description: Sends the custom channel payload to the specified [param peer_id]. With [param batched] as [code]true[/code], the payload queues into the peer aggregation buffers the session flushes at the end of its frame.

members.member: The channel identifier. Must be between 100 and 254.
